title: Settings or development: choose the appropriate change
goal: Distinguish a personal list setting from a structural configuration change and justify a minimal solution.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A colleague asks for “one more field”. Sometimes they only need a filter on existing minutes. Clarify the observable result before choosing a setting or a new stored value. This avoids rebuilding the service merely to change a list’s presentation.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Continue your service in a separate verified copy from the preceding lesson. Preserve the original and completedDT. The example adds a customer note; the independent task uses another document field in a further copy. Before changing anything verify the target and field list. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not operate the external1Capplication.

sections.title: Clarify the observable need
paragraphs: Make customers easier to use is not a complete specification. Ask whether the person needs to find an existing item, change a caption or store new text per customer. Those tasks use different mechanisms. Record an action and an observable acceptance result.

Our next task is precise: store a short training note separately from each customer name. It must survive writing and reopening the same item. Use synthetic information only; never put passwords, personal or business data in this field.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: A generic interface-change request can hide distinct needs.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

code.source:
Show requests ≥45 → list filter.
Change a readable object caption → metadata synonym.
Store each customer’s note → catalog attribute.

tables.caption: A field exists but is not visible

sections.title: Settings present existing data differently
paragraphs: A ≥45 filter selects requests, sorting changes order and grouping gathers details. They use existing fields without creating a Клиенты attribute or changing document storage structure. Disable the filter and compare original numbers to prove reversibility.

A setting may be saved per user and variant, but verify its actual scope in the application. Do not claim a personal filter changes all users. A visible column alone does not prove new storage; it might expose an existing field. Inspect metadata first.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: You need to see requests lasting at least 40 minutes. Must you add an attribute?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Minutes are already stored in the document; filter the existing field. Add an attribute when a new value must be stored, such as a separate training channel for each request.

sections.title: Names, synonyms and values serve different roles
paragraphs: In Designer open Справочники → Клиенты → Основные. Имя Клиенты participates in code such as Справочники.Клиенты. Синоним is its readable label. Учебный Север — ремонт is one Enterprise item’s name. Confusing these levels causes unnecessary changes.

A synonym change does not create another catalog; renaming an item does not add a field. A note needs a string attribute. Another application could offer an additional-attributes mechanism, but this small original package does not promise one. Do not search indefinitely or introduce third-party development for this exercise.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

flow.caption: Explore the example: Three needs, three mechanisms
alternative: Store: A new per-customer value → Attribute.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: If the attribute already exists, inspect its role and form instead of adding a duplicate.
Disable restrictions and compare original numbers before recreating records.

sections.title: A minimal change has boundaries and tests
paragraphs: Choose one УчебнаяЗаметка string attribute in existing Клиенты, synonym Учебная заметка, length 80 and optional. Retain existing names, codes, references and requests. The package’s automatically generated form should expose the field after updating; verify it instead of assuming this for every custom form.

Define acceptance first: the earlier item opens with the same code, its note writes and rereads, another customer initially has an empty note, and request totals/scope remain unchanged. Saving development and updating database configuration are separate actions in the next two lessons. Retain the original and verified .dt as return points.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Classify three new requests: show requests ≥40 minutes; display the label “Request channel”; store a training channel for each request. Choose a mechanism and check location for each. Explain why an individual request’s channel belongs to its document rather than all of a customer’s requests. Add nothing for the first request.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author created two new training copies by actualDTrestore. One applies customer note 80; the other adds request channel 40. Saving, restarting and comparing all eight old fields, identities and report 4/120 were performed. Two GUI captures show only saved values. Complete manual attribute creation, 80/81 and 40/41 boundaries, all learner steps, permissions and installer are NOT RUN.

Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: You need to see requests lasting at least 40 minutes. Must you add an attribute?
options: Yes: a new field is mandatory
selfcheck.feedback: No. Minutes are already stored in the document; filter the existing field. Add an attribute when a new value must be stored, such as a separate training channel for each request.

selfcheck.prompt: Where is a separate per-customer note stored?
selfcheck.feedback: An attribute holds the individual record value.

selfcheck.prompt: Before adding a field, you should
options: Check for an appropriate existing field

selfcheck.prompt: Where should each request’s channel be stored?
selfcheck.feedback: The first request uses a filter on existing ДлительностьМинут: visibility changes, not data. The second concerns a readable attribute synonym; it neither creates the attribute nor rewrites values. The third requires a new optional document attribute: two requests for one customer can have different channels. Distinguish a user setting, a structural definition and a particular request’s value; identical captions do not make them the same operation.
